breakdown.description: The crack is converted from two traction-free faces into a single continuous interior seam
breakdown.reason: The generated specification says the slit is represented as 'an interior boundary' in a 'conforming' mesh, which matches a single interior seam interpretation rather than two distinct crack faces. This does not match the ground truth requirement of a geometrically open crack with two separate traction-free faces.

breakdown.description: Dirichlet data are incorrectly extended from the outer boundary onto the slit faces
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly enforces Dirichlet boundary conditions on both the outer boundary and the slit faces using u0. Ground truth requires Dirichlet data only on the outer square boundary, with slit faces traction-free, so this inconsistency was not fixed.
